# Solix

> Solix puts your Mac's terminals, agents, and controls on your iPhone.

Solix is a Mojave Studio product: a macOS host app plus an iPhone companion for
opening terminals, guiding coding agents, and controlling your Mac remotely
over Wi-Fi or Tailscale. The host is signed for local use and is not notarized;
use a trusted LAN or Tailscale and do not expose it to the public internet.

## Read first

- [Homepage (Markdown)](https://solix.fyi/index.md): the same page content as Markdown.
- [Full CLI setup guide](https://github.com/Mojave-Studio/solix-skills): install and use the host CLI and skills.

## Downloads

- [Solix host for macOS](https://solix.fyi/Solix-macOS.zip): Apple silicon, signed for local use, not notarized.
- [Solix host for Windows](https://solix.fyi/solix-host-windows.exe): single binary — `solix-host serve` / `solix-host invite`.
- [Solix host for Linux](https://solix.fyi/solix-host-linux): single binary; optional [systemd user unit](https://solix.fyi/solix-host.service).

## Legal

- [Privacy Policy](https://solix.fyi/privacy): what the service stores (accounts + a device directory) and what never leaves your devices.
- [User Agreement](https://solix.fyi/terms): terms for the host software, iOS app, and backend service.

## Repositories

- [solix-skills](https://github.com/Mojave-Studio/solix-skills): agent skills for driving the host CLI.
- [solix-website](https://github.com/Mojave-Studio/solix-website): source for this site.
